preconditions.description: The number of days m and stores n are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= n - 1 for s_i in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: For each day, the number of stores Dora visits is at least 1 and at most n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= store_idx <= n for store_idx in stores) and len(stores) == len(set(stores)) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1:] for stores in [[int(x) for x in line.split()[1:]]])
preconditions.description: Store indices for each day are distinct integers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout_text.strip() == 'possible' if exists_valid_assignment(dora_sets, n) else stdout_text.strip() == 'impossible'
postconditions.description: Output 'possible' if there exists an assignment of positive integers to stores such that for every day, the LCM of Dora's chosen stores is strictly greater than the LCM of Swiper's chosen stores; otherwise output 'impossible'.
